source:
@@U01563@@
Serpent! Serpent!

@@U01565@@
(Aside.)

@@U01566@@
Yes, and I'll get you, too.

@@U01568@@
Monster! Get away!
Don't ever mention that lovely creature to me!
Never again waken to my half-crazed senses
my desire for her sweet body!

@@U01570@@
Well, then, what do you suggest?
As far as she’s concerned,
you've run off,
and that’s not too bad a guess.

@@U01572@@
No, not true.
I’m near her now;
no matter how far,
I can never forget her.
I envy the Body of our Lord the touch of her lips
when she receives it in Communion.

@@U01574@@
Splendid! Well said!
And I’ve often envied you that pair of
twins that feeds among the lilies.

@@U01576@@
Pimp!

@@U01577@@
Get out of my sight!

@@U01579@@
Fine!
Scold all you like,
it only makes me laugh.
translation:
@@U01563@@
蛇！蛇！

@@U01565@@
（旁边。）

@@U01566@@
是的，我也会去找你。

@@U01568@@
怪物！逃离！
永远不要向我提起那个可爱的生物！
再也不会被我半疯狂的感官唤醒
我对她甜美身体的渴望！

@@U01570@@
那么，你有什么建议呢？
就她而言，
你已经逃跑了
这个猜测还不错。

@@U01572@@
不，不是真的。
我现在就在她身边；
无论多远，
我永远无法忘记她。
我羡慕我们主的身体，她嘴唇的触碰
当她在圣餐中领受它时。

@@U01574@@
太棒了！说得好！
我也常常羡慕你们那一对
在百合花间进食的双胞胎。

@@U01576@@
皮条客！

@@U01577@@
滚出我的视线！

@@U01579@@
好吧！
随便骂吧
这只会让我发笑。
